experiment: known-scope shared guidance maintenance with adaptive tool use
hypothesis: For an already located shared-guidance edit, using the guidance generator directly avoids packet preparation and manual mirror maintenance overhead.
stoppingRule: Run all six fixed pairs once; retain every outcome. No replacement of slow, failed or incomplete runs. Only a concrete new defect can justify another separately versioned experiment. A failed threshold is a failed threshold, not grounds to add favorable repetitions.
baseline: Fresh agent manually maintains the shared block in all three host files; generic scripting allowed. Named new workflow tools unavailable.
treatment: Fresh agent edits canonical shared block and invokes generate-guidance.py. Skip packet creation for this known-scope task, as the revised workflow recommends. Generic scripting allowed.
sharedConditions: Same model/settings inherited; identical fixture source and task objective per pair; full root fixture AGENTS read required for both. Both may inspect sources and use general shell/Python. Tool/fixture setup after task_started is charged. Raw actual UTC observations; independent final exact-change validator.
agentAssignment: One fresh agent per trial, no agent runs both cohorts. Two waves of three matched pairs; alternate cohort launch order. Root records task_started immediately before dispatch, so model initiation/queue time is charged. Common fixture copies prepared beforehand identically; all cohort-specific preparation occurs after the start. Each wave completes before the next starts.
